about.journey: I've been fascinated by computers for as long as I can remember. Growing up, video games sparked my curiosity and eventually led me toward programming. I discovered that coding is a great way to turn ideas into real things digitally, which made web development a natural place for me to start.
about.interests: I enjoy building different kinds of things with code, especially web applications. Outside programming, I enjoy gaming and have a growing interest in photography.
about.futureGoals: My goal is to become a skilled software engineer capable of building high-quality applications across multiple platforms. I'm currently focused on full-stack web development, and in the future I plan to explore Android and iOS app development, UI/UX design, and graphic design to become a more versatile developer.
